item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 05/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The monsoon is expected to be gradually replaced by a maritime airstream in the middle and latter parts of this week. There will be mist over the coast of Guangdong.

PSR: Low
